manuscript.title: The Bogomolov–Pop reconstruction theorem
manuscript.main_theorem: For algebraically closed constants of characteristic != ell and relative transcendence degrees >=2, canonical map from perfect-closure field isomorphisms modulo Frobenius to bracket-compatible pro-ell abelian-by-central Galois data modulo ell-adic scalar units is BIJECTIVE.
main_theorem_component_results: surjectivity/existence for all admissible Galois isomorphisms
injectivity/uniqueness modulo Frobenius and scalar units
manuscript.source_proof_end: build/reconstruction.tex concludes existence/surjectivity and uniqueness/injectivity of canonical correspondence.
